fact: The September 2024 report states that LEAP's non-state partners, which collect data on student attendance, principal and teacher attendance and lesson delivery in 475 public schools (around 18% of Liberia's 2,703 public primary schools) and have built a per-pupil dataset for the five school years 2019-2024, are paid by philanthropic grant funding of more than USD 40 million since 2016, part of it through a pooled fund administered by Social Finance UK, and are accountable to the Ministry of Education.
title: Reflections and Learnings from the Liberia Education Advancement Program (LEAP): 2016-2024
